subject: general
question: All of the following are signals that sexual maturation is taking place, EXCEPT:

options.text: increased size and shape of breast or penis
girls begin to menstruate at around this time

solution:
The correct answer is __**blue colour of eyes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **blue colour of eyes** is not an indicator of sexual maturation.
 
• Sexual maturation involves significant physical and hormonal changes.
 
• These changes include the development of secondary sexual characteristics such as **increased size and shape of breasts or penis**.
 
• Another sign is the emergence of **different patterns of hair growth** in areas such as the underarms and pubic region.
 
• For girls, the beginning of **menstruation** is a clear signal of sexual maturation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Increased size and shape of breast or penis**__

 __
 
• The **growth of breasts** in females and the **enlargement of the penis** in males are primary indicators of sexual maturation.
 
• These changes are driven by **hormonal changes** during puberty.
 
 
 
• **Different patterns of hair growth**__
 __
 
• During puberty, both boys and girls develop **hair in new areas** such as the underarms, pubic region, and sometimes facial hair for boys.
 
• This is due to the increase in **androgen hormones**.
 
 
 
• **Girls begin to menstruate at around this time**__
 
 
• The onset of **menstruation**, also known as menarche, typically occurs between the ages of 11 and 14.
 
• This signifies that a girl’s body is capable of reproduction.
